newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tractor sales 13,050 in June--industry group.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tractor sales 13,050 in June--industry group.

text.p: The Equipment Manufacturers Institute said Thursday 13,050 farm tractors were sold in the United States in June, up from 11,732 a year ago.
Two-wheel drive farm tractor sales were 12,647 in the month, up from 11,448 a year ago and four-wheel drive sales were 403, up from 284 a year ago, the institute said.
Total farm tractor sales for the year through June were 66,361, up from 61,019 a year ago, the institute said.
Through June, two-wheel drive tractors sales were 63,337, up from 58,567 a year ago and four-wheel drive tractor sales were 3,024, up from 2,452 a year ago, the institute said.
